notes.title: Update 1.2 - What? Did you say local co-op?
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370163/540187db33e513aa23d6453a203fe5f6e5d80d63.jpg[/img]

Hi saviors of the tiny planets!

haven’t you ever dreamed of playing Tales of the Tiny Planet together with one of your friends? Yes or no doesn't matter, because now you can!

[b]We just added a local co-op mode where you can share a keyboard with a friend to help the tiny planets reunite.[/b] The controllable elements are divided among both players, so be sure to synchronize your timings. You're definitely going to argue.

If you don't have the game yet or wanted to gift it to someone, now is a good time because [b] we have a massive discount in the Winter Sale running[/b].

Nothing more to say here then have fun and enjoy Christmas time.

- Your PIXELSPLIT team

notes.title: New world, new mechanic (teleportals)! [Version 1.1.2]
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370163/e3f0c7dad35797ea1214d9cd7e27d17586664d1f.jpg[/img]

Hi,

we just released a new major update!

Discover the new mechanic of teleportals! These aren’t the portals to complete the level, but they will help you get there. Going through one of these teleportals will take you to the corresponding exit  of the same color. Your speed and direction will remain the same, so pay attention to where you are going!

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370163/34db67edea8b71a5cc4d5b483e471d47625c8e2d.gif[/img]

[h1]1.1.2 Patch notes:[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added a new 6th world (Pink planet) with new portal mechanics.
[*] Added a “Best time” popup to levels that you have already beaten, also viewable by pausing.
[*] Improved ingame button usability for keyboard/controller input.
[*] Updated application icon.
[*] Fixed a bug where the game could pause while in a transition screen.
[*] Some slight performance improvements.
[/list]

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29370163/c9f2d6d385ec4c604bafde81970188972e54dbac.gif[/img]

We hope you enjoy it! We'd appreciate any review for the game :)

- Your PIXELSPLIT Team

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2a
notes.content:
We just released a minor patch with the following changes.

Fixed the “Star collector” achievement not unlocking (collect 150 stars).
(P.s. if you already have over 150 stars, just open the ingame achievements menu.)

Slightly reduced the size of the spike collision areas, so the planet won’t explode just before he touches the spikes.

Fixed bug where marathon mode would not end when exiting the current level.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
In the last days we fixed some bugs. Here is the Changelog:

[list]
[*]Fixed rare bug where a planet could become immune to spikes after restarting.

[*]Fixed bug where planets would stop talking after going into the portal and then restarting the level (multi-planet levels).

[*]Fixed graphical problem with Brown Planet in world select.

[*]Fixed bug where settings could not be accessed through the ingame pause menu.

[*]Added a section in the “How to Play” that you can reset the level by pressing “R”

[*]Rebalanced a few of the end levels.
[/list]

- Pixelsplit
